role: Grok-only workarounds used by the tool-use loop: retry with a nudge when Grok announces a tool call without emitting one, and substitute a fallback message when a Grok turn ends blank or announce-only. Also the ChatTurn.roleSymbol UI helper.
types: GrokQuirkPolicy: struct (@MainActor) — per-turn Grok quirk state (owner, provider, turnID, retry counter)
ChatTurn: extension — roleSymbol for chat bubble
toplevel: maxAnnounceWithoutCallRetries = 2 and the static nudgeText are stored-property initializers; instances are created once per tool-use loop at AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift:63.

units.does: Memberwise init storing owner view model, provider and the assistant turn id.

After a text-only round: computes the round's new text for the live turn; if provider is Grok, under 2 retries, text looks like an announce-without-call, and the last outbound user turn asked for live data, increments the retry count, rewinds the buffer to round start and returns a synthetic user nudge turn; else nil. Called from AssistantToolRunner.runToolUseLoop.

branches.effect: true: roundText = turn text after roundStartTextLen; nil (turn gone): ?? '' empty string

branches.cond: provider is .grok AND retries < 2 AND announce pattern AND last user turn exists AND it asked for live data
branches.effect: false: returns nil (normal exit); true: retry++, log, rewind, return nudge ChatTurn

units.does: At normal end of a turn: for Grok only, if the live turn's trimmed text is empty or looks like an announce-without-call, replaces it with a localized 'Sorry — I didn't finish that answer' message and saves the conversation.

branches.cond: provider is .grok AND live turn index resolves

branches.effect: true: substitute fallback text, save, warn-log; false: leave text

units.does: Returns 'person.fill' for user turns, else the turn's providerID symbol or 'sparkles' when providerID is nil.

branches.effect: 'sparkles' used when the assistant turn has no providerID (e.g. local guard/deterministic replies)
